name: OutstandingCard
description: Dashboard hero card for the React Native mobile app — expected amount, a tappable Collected box with a progress bar (gradient, or solid success green at 100%), optional encouragement line, and an Outstanding amount with an optional invoices link.
notes: Progress bar's gradient fill is a solid Brand5 on native (no expo-linear-gradient dependency yet). Uses Lucide's CreditCard/Rocket/ChevronRight icons instead of porting accounting's custom SVG assets.
